_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA is known to millions around the world for creating the graphics chips used in personal computers, or PCs, that bring games and home movies to life.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'We expect substantial competition from both Intel's and AMD's strategy of selling platform solutions, including integrating a CPU and a GPU on the same chip or same package, as evidenced by AMD's announcement of its Fusion processors and Intel's announcement of its family of CPUs codenamed Sandy Bridge.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and has experienced severe downturns that have harmed, and may in the future harm, our business and financial results.' (FY2012 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.0%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.2%/yr (Q3 FY13 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +28.3%/yr (FY03-FY12 ex-FY09 ex-FY10 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +147.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2012-08-17) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.07x (21.6% downside to Bear $11.48 / +308.4% upside to Bull $59.83) | Adj composite 2.65 vs market 1.22: gap +1.43 [UNDERVALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $15.04 (16x FY13E $0.94) | Conservative 2-yr case: +87.8% total (+43.9%/yr) | At 15.6x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $19.37 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +2.7% YoY in Q2 FY13, forward revenues +7.9-17.2% (Q3 FY13 revenue guide (Q2 FY13 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
